headlines.text: Dow futures slide after Iranian projectiles hit a Saudi and a South Korean tanker in the Strait of Hormuz overnight.
Fed rate-hike odds for September climb to 57.5% as the 10-year Treasury yield hits its highest level since January 2025.
Wall Street closed lower Monday as the Dow fell 0.7%, the S&P 500 slipped 0.3%, and tech and utilities led the retreat.
JOLTS job openings and the ISM Manufacturing PMI land today, with factory activity seen cooling to 55.2% from July's 55.6%.
McKesson agrees to acquire Precision Medicine Group for $2.25 billion to bulk up its oncology and clinical-research business.
Crude oil holds near multi-month highs as the Hormuz tanker squeeze keeps a geopolitical risk premium baked into prices.
